messages.subject: geno.table p-values multiple testing correction
parts:
Hello,
Are the p-values generated by the geno.table function multiple testing corrected or do I need perform multiple testing correction after running the function ?

Thanks
Best Regards
Hamdi

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: geno.table p-values multiple testing correction
parts:
The p-values are *not* corrected for multiple testing. The p-values are straight out of chisq.test().

karl
